diagnostic_conclusion: The model successfully discriminates scarp boundaries from background terrain, but under severe class imbalance and 2 epochs of training, uncalibrated raw sigmoid outputs are shifted toward 0.95. At the default threshold (0.50), all pixels are predicted positive, mathematically fixing Dice to 2*prev/(1+prev)=0.0562. Calibrating the operating threshold to tau=0.975 on the validation set resolves this and increases Dice to 0.9485.
